wa_mount_prophet_east.descent_text: Descend the south ridge and brushy rib back to Thirtynine Mile Creek, retracing the ascent line to Big Beaver Trail.

wa_mount_rainier_fuhrer_finger.descent_text: Most parties descend a separate route (DC/Ingraham) or reverse the finger very early

wa_mount_rainier_sunset_ridge.descent_text: The usual way down is the Tahoma Glacier or its Sickle shortcut, which skirts the crevasses of the main glacier.
